1) Build, test, and lint commands
---------------------------------
If this project adds a language/tooling stack, populate this section with exact commands. Provide examples for running the full suite and running a single test. Example templates (replace with project-specific commands):

- Node/npm
  - Full test: npm test
  - Single test (Jest): npm test -- -t "<test name regex>"
  - Lint: npm run lint
  - Build: npm run build

- Python/pytest
  - Full test: pytest
  - Single test: pytest tests/test_module.py::TestClass::test_method
  - Lint: flake8 . || ruff .
  - Install: python -m pip install -r requirements.txt

- .NET
  - Full test: dotnet test
  - Single test: dotnet test --filter FullyQualifiedName~Namespace.Class.TestName

- Generic/Makefile
  - Full test: make test
  - Single test: make test TEST=tests/test_foo.py::test_bar

When adding commands, include OS-specific notes if necessary (Windows vs Unix). Put exact command lines — Copilot will use them to run and suggest code changes.
